messages.author: c33ba9be94bd4d2b
messages.subject: Deployed app halts with javascript error - fails to load selectize/bootstrap css
parts:
Hi,

I have built a Shiny app which works perfectly locally, but when I deploy it to shinyapps.io and log in to use it I get a grey screen after a few seconds. 
According to the logs it is loading the data correctly and successfully updates the choices for two selectizeInputs, before stopping.

The javascript console throws three errors for selectize/bootstrap css, pasted below.

Can anyone tell me whether this a problem I can resolve, or is it a server issue?

Many thanks,

Alex


### Javascript console output

I think the problem here is that your application is running out of memory. Try increasing the instance size using the configureApp function.

-Andy
